caveats.title: watchdog respawn race
caveats.detail: During the ~2-minute overlap (v2 spawned 04:26:16Z, old SIGTERM'd 04:27:00Z), both watchdogs polled. Both saw MISSING for all 3 signals so no double-dispatch occurred. If trigger had fired in that window, dispatch_eval is idempotent at the step-1 ssh layer (run_all_d_ckpts.sh is bash-write to ckpt_results/*.json — overwrite-safe), but step-2 scp could race and step-3 hexa verdict could be invoked twice. Mitigation: window was 44s and signals MISSING throughout; risk realized = 0.

caveats.title: trigger condition drift
caveats.detail: HF probe currently returns 401 (not 404). curl rc=22 from 401, hexa code returns 'MISSING:http_401' which DOES NOT match VALID prefix → no trigger. If repo visibility changes (e.g., public release before step-25000 tag push), 200 with empty tree could falsely trigger. _check_hf_repo only validates http_code==200, not body content. Acceptable for this cycle (training pushes step-25000 only on completion).

caveats.title: cross-axis depends on r=16/r=64 baselines
caveats.detail: Step 4 (cross-axis) requires state/p9_a_prime_main_eval_2026_05_03_verdict.json (Path A r=16/r=64 baseline) to exist. Per markers/path_a_r{16,64}_completion_watchdog_*.marker (last 13:24Z), Path A still in progress. If D 25K completes BEFORE Path A r=16/r=64 lands, cross-axis step SKIPS with reason 'path_a_verdict_missing' (D verdict still emitted standalone). Operator must manually re-fire cross-axis hexa once Path A baselines land.
